The plan below costs 496 minutes: 256 of driving and 240 in penalties.

**Syaphru school (4 children):** The only road there, from Dupcheshwar market, is impassable, so they can't be reached. They must be deferred, for a penalty of 4 × 60 = 240.

**Dupcheshwar market (7 elderly):** The only open route is via Shivapuri market, at 40 min each way, so a round trip takes 80 min.

| Option | Driving | Penalty | Cost |
|---|---|---|---|
| Two trips, rescue all 7 | 160 | 0 | **160** (best) |
| One trip, defer 3 | 80 | 150 | 230 |
| No trips, defer all 7 | 0 | 350 | 350 |

**Benighat market and Gosaikunda care home (7 adults):** Gosaikunda is a 40 min round trip, and Benighat, which is reached through Gosaikunda, is a 56 min round trip. With 4 seats, one trip can't carry all 7 adults.

| Option | Driving | Penalty | Cost |
|---|---|---|---|
| Two trips, rescue all 7 | 96 | 0 | **96** (best) |
| Benighat trip only, defer 3 | 56 | 60 | 116 |
| Gosaikunda trip only (3 adults), defer 4 | 40 | 80 | 120 |
| No trips, defer all 7 | 0 | 140 | 140 |

These two areas lie on separate routes from the shelter, so their trips can't be combined and each can be optimised on its own.

**Total:** 160 + 96 + 240 = 496
